Furniture lift hire

When the stairs or lift
are not enough.

CODEM hires out furniture lifts with an operator to households and businesses, by the half-day or day. A lift brings furniture through an upper-floor window when there is no lift, the lift is too small or corridors are narrow.

Sofas, wardrobes, pianos and other bulky items can be raised or lowered with suitable equipment, operated by a specialist technician.

  • Less risk to furniture and shared areas
  • For households and businesses
  • Parking and street constraints assessed

Start my quote

The right care.
The right preparation.

01

Assess the location.

The floor, opening dimensions, facade and available ground space determine feasibility. An intervention is confirmed only after assessment.

02

Plan parking and positioning.

Vehicle positioning and any required occupancy permissions need advance planning. Tell us about known restrictions so the intervention can be prepared.

03

Match handling to your furniture.

Dimensions, weight and fragility are assessed to identify suitable equipment. A furniture lift is one option to consider, not a universal solution.
